snapshot.title: PSSR Initiated — Restart Request Submitted

fields.cc: Plant Manager, Operations Superintendent, OT Engineer
fields.subject: PSSR Initiated — Restart Request Submitted
fields.body:
The Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) for Unit 300 (Rail Spot 2) has been formally initiated under PSM requirements. All changes resulting from the incident — including the unauthorized SIS logic update (v2.1.7 vs. archived v2.1.6), the remote session from TVC-JMP-01, and the Triconex key switch left in PROGRAM mode — have been documented in the PSSR log and on Form ERP-14.

The restart request has been submitted to the West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection (WV DEP) and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) via the corporate IT portal (Form ERP-14). All regulators have received the initial submission. Awaiting formal approval prior to any restart.

Per C1 and C4, restart is contingent upon: (1) successful PSSR, (2) SIS logic validation and proof test completion, (3) written Plant Manager approval, (4) notice to Teague County OEM, and (5) formal regulatory clearance. The EHS team will confirm no residual risk before final submission.
fields.signatureBlock:
Owen Ritchie, PSM Coordinator
Environmental, Health and Safety
